test_cleanup_forwards_populated_messages: test that _cleanup_agent_resources forwards the agent session messages to shutdown_memory_provider
test_cleanup_forwards_empty_list: test that _cleanup_agent_resources forwards an empty list when agent ran no turns
test_cleanup_missing_attribute_fallback: test that _cleanup_agent_resources falls back to no-arg call when _session_messages is missing
test_cleanup_magicmock_fallback: test that _cleanup_agent_resources falls back to no-arg call when agent is a MagicMock
test_cleanup_swallows_provider_exception: test that _cleanup_agent_resources swallows provider exceptions and still calls close
